description: Enumeration representing sub-status states for SavingsAccount within the Fineract project, providing status codes, labels, and utility methods.

classes.name: SavingsAccountSubStatusEnum
classes.description: Enum defining various sub-status states for SavingsAccount such as NONE, INACTIVE, DORMANT, etc., along with utility methods for state checks and value retrieval.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Returns the corresponding enum constant based on the integer code provided; defaults to NONE if no match.

methods.name: hasStateOf
methods.description: Checks if the current enum instance matches the given state.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the enum constant.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code associated with the enum constant.

methods.name: isSubStatusInactive
methods.description: Checks if the current status is INACTIVE.

methods.name: isSubStatusDormant
methods.description: Checks if the current status is DORMANT.

methods.name: isSubStatusNone
methods.description: Checks if the current status is NONE.

methods.name: isSubStatusEscheat
methods.description: Checks if the current status is ESCHEAT.

methods.name: isSubStatusAccountBlocked
methods.description: Checks if the current status is BLOCK.

methods.name: isSubStatusCreditBlocked
methods.description: Checks if the current status is BLOCK_CREDIT.

methods.name: isSubStatusDebitBlocked
methods.description: Checks if the current status is BLOCK_DEBIT.
